_about: Quests. `event` names the domain event that advances the quest and `kind` says how: COUNT increments once per event, DISTINCT collects the payload field named by `distinctBy`, STREAK counts consecutive windows. `window` is the bucket progress is kept in — an hour, an event-local day, or the whole event — and for a STREAK it is the step of the streak instead. `anchoredToDuty` means progress only counts while the player is checked in to a shift. A `sticker` reward must be an item id from memorabilia.json, and its `drop` line there should describe the same thing this quest asks for.

quests.title: Sign the Roster
quests.blurb: Claim a shift, any shift. The board empties faster than anyone expects.

quests.title: Green Light
quests.blurb: Hold your rotating token under a desk scanner and watch it go green.

quests.title: Supply Run
quests.blurb: Two beacons inside the hour, without wandering off your post.

quests.title: Beacon Circuit
quests.blurb: Five different beacons in a day. The Quad is four hundred metres end to end.

quests.title: Four Desks
quests.blurb: Check in at four different shifts over the weekend. Registration, food, hardware, the 3 AM one nobody wanted.

quests.title: Dispatch Ready
quests.blurb: Close three distress calls in one day while you are on shift.

quests.title: Broad Triage
quests.blurb: Resolve calls in three different categories. A dead laptop and an empty stomach are the same emergency at 4 AM.

quests.title: Dependable
quests.blurb: Finish a shift on three days running. A missed day starts the count again.

quests.title: Double Back
quests.blurb: Two shifts finished on the same day. The second one is the one that counts.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.blurb: Take three different strongholds for your faction. Altgeld rings for whoever holds it.

quests.title: Sponsor Row
quests.blurb: Scan four sponsor booths. They flew in to meet you, not the swag table.
